description: This file implements functions for constructing, parsing, and validating netlink attributes, including handling nested attributes and various data types, as part of a netlink communication library.

methods.name: nla_ok
methods.description: Checks if the attribute header and payload can be accessed safely within the remaining stream.

methods.name: nla_next
methods.description: Returns the next attribute in a stream based on the current attribute's length.

methods.name: validate_nla
methods.description: Validates an individual netlink attribute against a policy.

methods.name: nla_parse
methods.description: Creates an index array of attributes from a stream, optionally validating each.

methods.name: nla_validate
methods.description: Validates a stream of attributes against a policy.

methods.name: nla_find
methods.description: Finds the first attribute of a specific type within a stream.

methods.name: nla_reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for an attribute in a netlink message and initializes its header.

methods.name: nla_put
methods.description: Adds a data payload as an attribute to a netlink message.
